headlines.title: Freedom Broker cuts PayPal to Hold as branded checkout stalls
headlines.summary: Investing.com -- Freedom Broker downgraded PayPal to Hold from Buy and cut its price target to $63 from $72 in a note Wednesday, saying the payments company’s branded checkout business has failed to reaccelerate.

headlines.title: Justt Launches 'Flows,' Its New Chargeback Automation Engine
headlines.summary: Justt, the AI-native platform for enterprise chargeback management, today announced three upgrades to its platform: Justt Flows, a no-code automation engine for alerts and chargebacks; Consistent Disputers, which identifies cardholders who dispute purchases again and again; and PayPal Alerts, which gives merchants pre-chargeback warnings that card-network alert vendors cannot see. Together, they extend Justt from fighting chargebacks to both preventing them and acting on what they reveal.

headlines.title: 5 Payment Stocks That Earn a Fee Every Time You Swipe
headlines.summary: Each of these businesses gets paid when you pay. Why does the market price some of those fees at around three times the rest?

headlines.title: University of North Carolina's SpaceX windfall traces back to $2M check
headlines.summary: The University of North Carolina’s exceptional 2026 returns trace back to a $2 million investment made in SpaceX in 2009, according to people familiar with the matter. UNC Management Company, which invests on behalf of the 17 institutions that make up the North Carolina university system, made the investment through Founders Fund, a VC firm in which PayPal co-founder Peter Thiel is a partner.

headlines.title: Byron Donalds Could Be Next Florida Governor: Here Are the Stocks He's Been Buying in 2026
headlines.summary: Congressman Byron Donalds (R-Fla.) is among the current members of Congress who are not running for re-election in the 2026 midterms. Instead, Donald has his eye set on a new political title: governor of Florida.

description: PayPal Holdings, Inc. operates a technology platform that enables digital payments for merchants and consumers worldwide. The company operates a two-sided network at scale that connects merchants and consumers that enables its customers to connect, transact, and send and receive payments through online and in person, as well as transfer and withdraw funds using various funding sources, such as bank accounts, PayPal or Venmo account balance, consumer credit and debit products, credit and debit cards, and cryptocurrencies, as well as other stored value products, including gift cards and eligible rewards. It provides payment solutions under the PayPal, PayPal Credit, Braintree, Venmo, Xoom, Hyperwallet, Honey, and Paidy names. The company was founded in 1998 and is headquartered in San Jose, California.
